verdict.rationale: Penpot says it will never make business out of your data. It also lets you self-host Penpot and its MCP server in environments you control, and connect only AI agents or LLMs you trust. That gives users practical control that keeps design data away from vendor or third-party AI training. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party policy stating user data is not used for AI model training, a documented opt-out or setting for hosted-instance users, and independent corroboration of the privacy posture.
